title: Towards Risk-free AI Agent Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2608.16411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents are rapidly moving from research prototypes into the core business processes of organizations, but these agents pose deployment risks to security, compliance, and functionality. In this article, we argue that risk-free deployment must be grounded in the agent's trajectory: the recorded sequence of reasoning steps, tool invocations, and environmental observations. Trajectories are available for any agent, and many failures are visible only in the trajectory. To make agents deployable and sustainable, we advocate agent testing and debugging as a systematic research direction for detecting and mitigating these risks. This article begins with the challenges of testing agents, including the oracle problem, non-determinism, trajectory validation, and the absence of adequacy metrics. We then turn to debugging agents, from automated failure attribution to repair and self-evolution. We distill these directions into a practical

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16411v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于大型语言模型的代理正迅速从研究原型转变为组织的核心业务流程，但这些代理在安全性、合规性和功能性方面带来了部署风险。在本文中，我们认为无风险部署必须基于代理的轨迹：记录推理步骤、工具调用和环境观察的序列。轨迹适用于任何代理，且许多失败仅在轨迹中可见。为了使代理可部署且可持续，我们主张将代理测试和调试作为检测和缓解这些风险的系统性研究方向。本文首先探讨了测试代理的挑战，包括预言问题、非确定性、轨迹验证以及充分性指标的缺失。然后转向调试代理，从自动化故障归因到修复和自进化。我们将这些方向提炼为一个实用框架。
tldr: 本文提出，通过系统性地测试和调试代理的轨迹记录，来检测和缓解基于LLM的代理在部署中的安全、合规和功能风险，从而推动无风险部署。
en_tdlr: This article proposes systematic testing and debugging of agent trajectories to detect and mitigate security, compliance, and functional risks in LLM-based agent deployment, enabling risk-free deployment.
